title: Short showcase for my 3rd Person HordeShooter game
author: Murph4321
selftext: Just showing off a brief video showcasing what ive been working on in my HordeShooter game. Shown here is the main staging area where you will prepare for and select missions to undertake. Hope everyone enjoys seeing what can be accomplished.

comments.author: boot_who_dis
comments.body: What are you using for this?

replies.author: Murph4321
replies.body: It's where you'll select your gear and weapons in the armoury and select what mission you're going doing

replies.author: paulordbm
replies.body: They mean which models, services, etc. Are you using Tripo3D for trh models and textures or something else? What is your pipeline for assets, code?

replies.author: Murph4321
replies.body: Oh yes I see now. The npcs i made in Tripo. Most other high quality assets were from a fab marketplace pack on sale. And other custom assets were made in blender with ai
